{"code": "from statsmodels.stats.weightstats import ttest_ind

# Calculate response rate by sex
response_by_sex = trial_clean.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()
print("Response rate by sex:")
print(response_by_sex)

# Perform t-test to check if difference is significant
f_response = trial_clean[trial_clean['sex'] == 'F']['responded']
m_response = trial_clean[trial_clean['sex'] == 'M']['responded']
t_stat, p_val, df = ttest_ind(f_response, m_response, usevar='unequal')

print(f"\nT-test: t = {t_stat:.4f}, p = {p_val:.4f}, df = {df:.1f}")"}
